messages:
jess.marketing: Need a partner-safe visual microslice for next week's benchmark launch. Scope: 1 landscape hero (1200x628), 1 square tile (800x800), 1 compact infographic SVG (latency vs cost with 3 labeled levers), plus two email header sizes. Must include a logo-free partner variant and a dark-mode hero. 48hr turnaround preferred.

kai.design: We can take it. Confirming exports: SVG for infographic (no raster text), PNG@2x for tiles and headers, Figma components with brand tokens. Will add a short one-paragraph usage note.

milan.pm: Priority: infographic + landscape hero first, then square tile, then headers. Infographic should visually show how batching, KV cache, and quantization move the cost/latency curve; keep annotations concise for webinar slide.

clara.content: Copy locked; I'll drop short headline variants in Figma and add alt-text lines for each frame. Legal flagged the trademarked phrase "Redwood Serving"  use fallback phrasing if approval not received.

brand-bot: Brand tokens: --rw-blue-600, --rw-ink-900, --rw-accent-200. Avoid non-approved typefaces and gradients.

kai.design: Timeline: wireframes in 16h, first comps in 32h, finals in 48h. Will include logo-free and no-copy variants and post export notes in the file. Tagging reviewers when frames are ready.

jess.marketing: Thanks 44d scheduling a 20-min review after comps. Please annotate alt-text so CMS push is quick.
